column1: A person eligible to be appointed as a Member of a Panel of Mediators, in the Special Mediation Board area specified
in the Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2125/8 of May 27, 2019 relating to a dispute of the category of
disputes determined by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2078/36 dated July 04, 2018, shall :-

column2: be between 35 to 70 years of age;
be a resident of the Special Mediation Board area;
have a professional or academic qualification obtained from a recognized professional or
higher education body established by or under any written law; and
have been or be a public officer, or a person who holds knowledge and skills in an area
relevant to settlements of disputes and grievances of migrant workers.
